assumed: That the shipped VCL30.dpl and the game binaries behave as the Delphi 3.02 RTL source above (not traced at run time; the game was not run).

Region boundaries between local entries are approximated by the previous entry's stub end. Methods "externals" and "dependency-replay" use Delphi 3 SOURCE external/uses clauses (and recovered src/delphi3 uses clauses and project files for the replay); "dependency-replay" names a slot only where the replay puts the same two named neighbours adjacent and inserts exactly as many unnamed units. "resourcestring-records" and "class-name" are name heuristics, noted in evidence.
verified_in_delphi3_source_only: System.InitUnits (SOURCE/RTL/SYS/SYSTEM.PAS) calls Table[I].Init for I = 0..Count-1, recording InitCount before each call; FInitUnits calls FInit for InitCount-1 down to 0 (so only units that were started are finalized, in reverse).

A package DLL entry (_InitPkg in SYSINIT.PAS) does not run its own table; the table runs only through the exported Initialize (_PackageLoad), i.e. for LoadPackage. For packages that AoW.exe imports statically, the units are initialized from the exe's table via the import thunks; the counters make a later run of a package table (or a unit listed in several tables) a no-op for units already initialized.
verified_in_original_binaries: Each table is the compiler-emitted PackageUnitEntry array {Init, FInit}: for a .dpl the pointer returned by @GetPackageInfoTable (mov eax, imm32), for an .exe the table pointer loaded at the entry point before the call to _InitExe; count and records read from the files.

Per-unit counter guard: a unit init starts "sub dword ptr [counter],1; jae <skip>" and its finalization is a try/finally around "inc dword ptr [counter]; jne <skip>" (disassembled: AoWEPACK.dpl AoWE.AoWE@00000000 / AoWE.Finalization). A unit with no initialization section still gets a 0x38-byte stub with the same counter: FInit, then Init = "sub [counter],1; ret" (AoW.exe 0x401220..0x401257). So the body runs only on the first Init call and finalization only when the counter returns to zero.

An entry for a unit that lives in a required package is an import thunk (jmp [IAT]) to that package's exported Unit.Unit@00000000 init; via_package is the thunk's DLL. The exe tables therefore list every packaged unit the program reaches, in the exe's own order.

Weak-packaged units (PACKAGEINFO unit flag 4; all 23 are in VCL30.dpl) and SysInit are compiled into each client as local entries with their own counter; their DLL externals are imported directly by the client and the thunks sit in that unit's code region.
For the exes, table order differs from both PACKAGEINFO unit order and code (link) order (e.g. AoW.exe position 211 FontMod has the lowest code address of the contained units).

Table order versus Delphi 3 RTL/VCL source uses clauses: in VCL30/VCLX30/VCLDB30 and the game packages that do not import AoWEPACK, no named unit precedes a unit it uses except inside uses cycles (counted in dependency_check.used_unit_later_but_mutual_uses). Modules that import AoWEPACK do show such cases against the recovered sources (dependency_check.order_violations, e.g. AoW.exe AoWReg at 65 before Sound at 68), so the client table is not a strict dependency order for imported package units, or the recovered uses clauses differ from the originals.
